say: All three bots fight at once, with two lives each.
Claude's dots, ChatGPT's inhale and Stack Overflow's beam all go off in the first few seconds.
Stack Overflow punches its way in, and its beam knocks ChatGPT out.
ChatGPT comes back, and its cursor takes control of Stack Overflow.
A low kick and the beam knock Claude out next.
Then Stack Overflow is knocked out too, so everyone is down to one life.
ChatGPT compacts Claude and takes it over, and Claude is out of the match.
It comes down to Stack Overflow against ChatGPT, and Stack Overflow wins.
